scope: Joined actual home controller, top-level permit/mux, runtime reset/backend arbiter and UART bridge/TX/RX. Response admission is model-bound and authorized, an in-flight packet retains enough permission budget and cannot be interrupted by nonterminal home transport; revoked/expired permission suppresses runtime requests and token output. Crypto verdicts/private boot/nonce seams remain abstract. Binary clocked async2sync model; not a whole-machine numerical or physical security theorem.
